source_basis.reference: Ross PJ (2011), Numerical Solution of the Continuity Equation for Soil Water Flow Using Precomputed Steady-State Fluxes, Vadose Zone Journal 10:760-766, doi:10.2136/vzj2010.0085
relevant_method_points: steady-state flux responses are precomputed from Darcy flow and interpolated during the continuity solve
the paper explicitly identifies quadratic interpolation with smaller tables as a possible accuracy/speed trade-off
changing interpolation order does not change the requested hydraulic constitutive law

purpose: Determine whether changing only the local face-response interpolation law, while freezing the best precommitted R2A node set and all physical semantics, resolves the remaining B12/O13 near-saturation WET_DRY errors without density or coordinate retuning.

fixed_node_representation.saturated_wet_coordinate: linear pressure head h on [0,+1] cm
fixed_node_representation.node_values: unchanged exact steady-Darcy oracle values used by the R2A formulation

candidate_face_interpolation.arithmetic: promote nine float32 logM nodes to binary64 and evaluate tensor-product degree-2 Lagrange interpolation
candidate_face_interpolation.wet_stencil: three nearest nodes within the active unsaturated-t or saturated-h branch; one-sided [0,1,2] and [N-3,N-2,N-1] at branch edges
candidate_face_interpolation.dry_stencil: three nearest u nodes with the same deterministic one-sided edge rule
candidate_face_interpolation.exact_node_property: Lagrange interpolation reproduces stored node values exactly apart from binary64 arithmetic
candidate_face_interpolation.cross_h0_rule: never construct a polynomial using nodes from both physical branches; h<0 uses the unsaturated t branch and h>=0 uses the saturated head branch, which share the physical h=0 endpoint

comparison_baseline: Also evaluate the prior A33_SAT17 bilinear logM law on exactly the same probes, but do not use baseline performance to alter thresholds or Q2 policy.

probe_plan.fresh_distribution: uniform physical wet h over [-1,+1] and uniform dry u over [0,4]

required_diagnostics: Q2 and bilinear metrics on identical probes
deterministic stencil indices and Lagrange weights for the worst Q2 probe
table loads and conceptual shared-memory footprint
hard_guards: No new nodes, density tuning, coordinate tuning or threshold relaxation.
No physical constitutive change and no Class-B reopening.
No fallback from Q2 to bilinear selected after observing errors.
Characterization only. A PASS permits a separately frozen all-region/full-stress qualification path; it is not saturation-transition admission.
A FAIL closes the precomputed near-saturation table approach for the base family and routes research to a bounded local face solve or another non-table formulation.
